instruction.text: Write a sequence using the following information.

atoms.a: A car is travelling at 20mph and then accelerates to 32mph the next second. The car maintains the same acceleration.

instruction.text: Write a sequence using the following information.

atoms.a: A museum has 109 visitors. One hour later, there are 90. The same amount of visitors leave each hour.
At this rate, how many more hours would it take for the museum to empty?

instruction.text: Write a sequence using the following information.

atoms.a: One end of a sand timer is <mat>7/8</mat> full. It is then flipped and after a minute it is only <mat>5/8</mat> full. The same amount of sand falls every minute
What is the maximum amount of time the timer can record?

hint.text: The sand timer loses <mat>2/8</mat> of sand every minute. One end can hold the full <mat>8/8</mat>.

instruction.text: Write a sequence using the following information.

atoms.a: One Monday in winter, the temperature was 4°C above freezing. The next day, the temperature was only 2.5°C. The temperature continued dropping at the same rate all week.
What was the temperature on Friday?
